relationship.instructions: Judge whether the two supplied reports describe the same underlying problem, distinct problems, or an ambiguous relationship. Use only the bounded evidence supplied after exact duplicate identifiers and hard conflicts have already been checked.

criteria.same_problem: The reports describe materially the same underlying failure or defect despite differences in wording, reporter, or reproduction details.
criteria.different_problem: The reports describe materially different failure modes, causes, or affected behavior.
criteria.ambiguous: The reports overlap in topic or symptoms, but the evidence is insufficient or mixed for a reliable same-problem judgment.

left.summary: Uploading a large attachment reaches 100% and then remains on Processing forever.
left.observedBehavior: large upload stalls after transfer completes

right.summary: Files around 200 MB finish sending but the UI never leaves the processing state.
right.observedBehavior: large file remains processing after bytes finish uploading

left.summary: CSV export times out for very large projects.

right.summary: JSON export returns permission denied for viewer accounts.

left.summary: Some records appear missing after background synchronization.

right.summary: A user reports stale data after sync but the report does not identify which records or whether they were absent or outdated.
right.observedBehavior: stale or incomplete data after sync
